name: convenient-security
description: Heap-safe Node.js client for the Convenient Security secrets agent
author: Stateful Ltd

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && node scripts/write-package-markers.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test test/bridge-path-erofs.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs
